facts.value: Claude Code plugin (Flight Check) distributed through a plugin marketplace. It is a developer and audit tool, not a hosted application.
No web or application framework. The plugin consists of Claude Code agent and skill markdown prompts plus a Python standard-library CLI that uses argparse.
Python (CI matrix 3.9 and 3.12) for the CLI, library, tests, and tools. Markdown prompts and JSON reference data. Node is used only for CI tooling.
CPython 3.9+ run locally by the user. Claude Code is the host for the agents. Node 22 is used in CI only.
The runtime has no third-party dependencies. CI uses pip with a hash-pinned requirements file (test-only tools) and npm with a lockfile (package-lock.json) to install a pinned Claude Code.
No database. State is kept in local JSON files (.flight-check/ledger.json and similar).

evidence.searched: Glob for sql, migrations and schema files under plugins/. Grep for sqlite3 and DB client imports in plugins/flight-check/scripts. No matches.

facts.value: None. A local CLI and prompts with no user accounts.

facts.value: No user authorization model. Agents are restricted by their tool allowlists (the inventory agent is Read, Grep, Glob only). Hardened-mode and security-design docs describe the read-only design, which was not verified in depth.
No HTTP API. The interfaces are a subcommand CLI (flight_check.py, with the logic in flight_check_lib/cli.py) and Claude Code skills (audit, remediate, track, status, legal-packet).
None. No HTML, CSS, JS or TS files under plugins/. Output is JSON, markdown and a PDF produced by pdf.py.

evidence.searched: Glob for html, css, js, ts and tsx under plugins/. No files found.

facts.value: Local Python CLI and library modules (catalog, evidence, fingerprint, lockfile, minischema, jsonio, pdf, textsafety) orchestrated by prompt-defined agents: inventory, appsec, data, payments, ai, a11y, platform, supply-chain, testing, governance, verifier.
Distributed as a Claude Code plugin through a marketplace.json in a GitHub repository. There is no server deployment.
The code is hosted on GitHub. CI runs on GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runners.
Local filesystem JSON state and evidence under .flight-check/.
The CLI reads, writes and hashes local project files and generates PDFs. It validates quotes against files and has text-safety and JSON I/O hardening modules. No upload handling.
No payment code or SDKs.

evidence.searched: Inspected the file layout, manifests and dependency lists (npm and pip). No payment dependencies. The payments.md file is an audit agent prompt, not payment code. Did not Grep payment terms across the repo.

facts.value: No runtime third-party services in the code. Dependencies are the GitHub Actions used in CI, the Claude Code CLI and the npm registry.
Claude Code hosts the LLM-driven agents, which are markdown prompts. Blindtest tools drive audits against test apps. The plugin itself has no direct LLM SDK calls.
A FLIGHT_CHECK_LEAK_DENYLIST env var and secret are used in CI lint. There are no .env files.

GitHub Actions runs unit tests and lint on Python 3.9 and 3.12, plus a strict Claude Code plugin validation. Actions are pinned by SHA, permissions are contents: read, and credentials are not persisted. No release or deploy workflow is present (releasing.md documents a manual process).
unittest suite under tests/unit with a fixture target (tests/fixtures/mini-target), plus blind-test tooling in tools/blindtest.
